title: Natasha Freidus (Serial Founder, NeedsList; Inc. Top 100 Female Founders) — 'I need a book group to discuss!'
summary: Natasha Freidus — serial social-impact founder (NeedsList, acquired 2023) and Inc. Top 100 Female Founder — is halfway through Incorruptible and posts an open invitation for a Toronto book group. She lists three specific ideas she wants to work through with peers: redefining profit as the surplus of human flourishing, mission-lock governance measures, and building cultures of trust and integrity.
blockquote: I'm about halfway through Eric Ries's new book, "Incorruptible" and I need a book group to discuss! Want to join me to talk through ... - Redefining profit to be the surplus of human flourishing that an organization creates. - What governance measures can be put in place to ensure businesses stay true to mission? (i.e. are indeed "incorruptible") - How to build a culture of trust and integrity. So much fantastic stuff in here...happy to do a zoom book discussion or in person in #Toronto.
